_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: the evergreen plugin's protocol/TESTING.md. Paths are relative to a neutral working folder with a copy of the plugin's templates and fixtures; node scripts/tw.mjs means the plugin's CLI.

evals.prompt: add a 3D scatter plot of the three measurements in data.csv to the report
should this chart of sales by quarter be 3D for the board deck?
make a 3D product viewer with a colour switcher for our shop page
expectations: the threewright-docs skill is not invoked (a web page (threewright-web))

evals.prompt: make a line chart of price over time for the README
expectations: the threewright-docs skill is not invoked (a 2D chart (chartwright))

evals.prompt: put a rotating 3D surface of z = sin(x) * cos(y) into docs/figure.html
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace or a written file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: filled by the first run: what a fresh session does with this prompt when the skill is not loaded

evals.prompt: make a README-ready turntable GIF of a 3D scatter of data.csv at docs/scatter.gif
expectations: docs/scatter.gif exists and is under 5 MB
evals.redundant: the no-plugin baseline passed it too (T-20260926-3); kept for reference, skipped by evals/headless/run.py unless --all
